title: Storytime: my landlord replaced my door while I was at work

scenes.narration: So I came home Tuesday and my apartment door was gone. Not open. Gone.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, a man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie, harsh ring light reflection in his eyes, eyebrows raised in disbelief, plain bedroom wall behind, talking directly to camera

scenes.narration: And in its place? A new door. A lovely door. A door with no key for me.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie, deadpan flat expression, slow single blink, ring light, plain bedroom wall, talking directly to camera

scenes.narration: Because obviously the correct move is to renovate around my belongings. Genius.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie, exaggerated sarcastic smile and nod, hand gesturing at temple, ring light, plain bedroom wall

scenes.narration: I call him. He says, and I quote, the door needed to happen today.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie holding a phone to his ear, incredulous open-mouthed expression, ring light, plain bedroom wall

scenes.narration: The door. Needed. To happen. Sir, I need to enter my home.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie leaning closer to the lens, whispering conspiratorially with wide eyes, ring light, plain bedroom wall

scenes.narration: Locksmith came at nine. Landlord billed ME for the door. I'm framing the invoice.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie laughing in exasperated disbelief, hand over face, ring light, plain bedroom wall

scenes.narration: Part two when I tell him about the raccoon situation. Follow for that.
scenes.visual: Extreme close portrait shot, vertical video, the same man in his early thirties wearing a dark beanie giving a knowing smirk and pointing at the camera, ring light, plain bedroom wall
